ThreeOilLowCost.help: Use a 3-oil low-cost fleet to fight. Automatically replaces and retires the flagship when it reaches level 32.

Coalition.name: Light & Shadow Fashion - Shooting in Progress

CoalitionScuttle.name: Coalition Scuttle
CoalitionScuttle.help: Farm affinity by having ships sunk in Coalition events. Recommend sortie with multiple fleets; the first fleet sinks. Refer to tutorials for details.

WarArchives.name: War Archives
WarArchives.help: Due to lack of maintenance for War Archives, the clearing function may not work properly. If you find AzurPilot running abnormally, please complete the clearing manually and then use the auto-search function.

CoalitionSp.name: Tales of the Strange: Escape from White Night Villa SP

StorageStatistics.name: Inventory statistics
StorageStatistics.help: Scan and verify the material inventory twice before updating Statistics. Disabled by default; can be run manually. Does not consume items. Currently verified for CN only.

Secretary.name: Secretary
Secretary.help: Automatically monitor the secretary ship's affinity and replace it when it reaches 90 affinity

OperationHandover.name: Operation Handover Contract
OperationHandover.help: Consume Handover Books to run Operation Handover automatically.

Minigame.name: Mini Game
Minigame.help: Automatically collects game coins when they won't overflow. Automatically plays mini-games when there are game coins and rewards are not full.

OpsiExploreCleanup.name: Ordinary-zone event cleanup
OpsiExploreCleanup.help: Requires 100% monthly exploration. Revisit original DANGEROUS zones in exploration order, scan the full map and every fleet radar, and handle missed events and their enemies. Never enter SAFE zones. Uses separate monthly checkpoints saved after leaving each zone, without repeating completed months. If exploration is incomplete, ask to rerun monthly exploration.

OpsiArchive.name: Archive Coordinates
OpsiArchive.help:
Purchase archive coordinates from the Voucher Shop and run them. Archive zones do not consume action points.
The following conditions must be met before using this feature:
- Clear the Operation Siren main story and complete Simulation + Siren Proving Grounds
- Enable Operation Siren exploration missions or use Campaign Data Logger (5000 oil item)

OpsiScheduling.name: Smart Scheduling
OpsiScheduling.help:
Operation Siren smart scheduling function, used to coordinate switching between Corrosion 1 leveling and gold coin replenishment tasks.
Once enabled, it will automatically switch between different tasks and send push notifications based on gold coins and action points.

OpsiPreventActionPointOverflow.name: Prevent AP Overflow
OpsiPreventActionPointOverflow.help: Runs Operation Siren tasks when current AP reaches the upper limit.

OpsiCrossMonth.name: Cross-Month Daily
OpsiCrossMonth.help:
AzurPilot will enter Operation Siren 10 minutes before the cross-month reset, wait for the reset without exiting, then complete the new day's OpSi daily, Obscured Zone, Abyssal Zone and Meowfficer Farming to earn extra rewards. When running OpSi Daily, it follows the "OpSi - Daily" task settings, and likewise for others.
    Important: Do not operate the game while AzurPilot is waiting for the cross-month reset.

OpsiSimulator.name: OpSi Simulator Alpha
OpsiSimulator.help:
Uses the Monte Carlo algorithm to estimate the outcome of continuing corrosion cycles for a period of time in the current state. This feature does not affect AzurPilot's normal operation.
Model parameters are taken from AzurPilot configuration and statistics. Please ensure that OpSi settings such as Smart Scheduling are correctly configured.
Currently in beta; results may not have much reference value.
The model for the shady dealer selling Action Points lacks sufficient evidence. Specifically, it assumes that the dealer's 6 types of AP boxes follow a hypergeometric distribution X~H(6,6,24).
Regarding "crashes": here, a crash means that during the entire simulation, AP drops below the AP reserve threshold set in Smart Scheduling at least once. If it falls below that threshold, the simulator will stop corrosion cycles and wait for AP to recover naturally.

IslandPlan.name: Global Config
IslandPlan.help: Global configuration for Island Plan, including season settings.

IslandBusiness.name: Business Module
IslandBusiness.help: Auto-manage 5 shops: Fish Restaurant, Polar Bear Drinks, Squid Grill, Juu Eatery, Juu Coffee.

IslandGrill.name: Squid Grill
IslandGrill.help: Sequentially produce meals matching the menu requirements.

IslandJuuEatery.name: Juu Eatery
IslandJuuEatery.help: Sequentially produce meals matching the menu requirements.

IslandJuuCoffee.name: Juu Coffee
IslandJuuCoffee.help: Sequentially produce meals matching the menu requirements.

IslandDailyGather.name: Daily Gathering
IslandDailyGather.help: Gather resources from the management interface gathering tab.

IslandAirDrop.name: Daily Supply
IslandAirDrop.help: Island movement only supports the minitouch / MaaTouch / uiautomator2 / azurpilot_android control methods. Collects your own island's daily airdrop and can visit other players' islands for supplies.

IslandDailyOrder.name: Daily Order
IslandDailyOrder.help: Enter the daily order interface from the island phone page, automatically detect order types (Urgent/Challenge/Easy), deliver or reject based on item conditions. "Standard" type orders are not supported.

IslandDailyInteract.name: Daily/Weekly Tasks
IslandDailyInteract.help: Island movement only supports the minitouch / MaaTouch / uiautomator2 / azurpilot_android control methods. Handles island petting, JUU Express, Business Delivery, and weekly photo tasks. Enable after related button assets are generated.

IslandPearlSell.name: Weekly Pearl Trade
IslandPearlSell.help: Island movement only supports the minitouch / MaaTouch / uiautomator2 / azurpilot_android control methods. Process pearls every Tuesday at 01:00.

FleetInfo.name: Fleet Information
FleetInfo.help: View the latest fleet scan result

AutoEquip.name: Auto Equip
AutoEquip.help: Starts from the first dock ship, opens quick equipment change, enables the equipping filter, then swipes through ship details. The actual equipment strategy is not configured yet.

EmulatorManager.name: Emulator Manager
EmulatorManager.help: Provides an entry point for manually restarting the emulator.

MeowfficerScore.name: Meowfficer Score
MeowfficerScore.help: Read meowfficer talents and score them with public guide rules

Enable.name: Enable this feature
Enable.help: Add this task to the scheduler

PushNotification.name: Push Notification
PushNotification.help: Send push notification via OnePush when a task completes, including success or failure status

NextRun.name: Next run time
NextRun.help: The value is automatically calculated and does not need to be modified manually. Will run immediately after clearing

SuccessInterval.name: After a successful run, postpone the next run for X minutes

FailureInterval.name: After a run fails, postpone the next run for X minutes

ServerUpdate.name: Server refresh time
ServerUpdate.help:
After some tasks run successfully, the next run will be postponed until the server refresh time
Automatically converts time zones, generally no modification is required

Sensitive.name: Sensitive task
Sensitive.help: When an error occurs, prohibit restarting the game and stop AzurPilot immediately. Suitable for critical timing tasks like cross-month daily, Obscured Zones, Abyssal Zones, etc.

RandomDelay.name: Daily restart random delay
RandomDelay.help:
When restarting the game client each day, delay the restart by X random minutes after the server refresh time to stagger logins across multiple clients.
Supports a single number or a range, for example 5, 50. Set to 0 to disable.

ClearCache.name: Clear cache on restart
ClearCache.help: When restarting the game client, delete external cache files under /sdcard/Android/data/<package>/cache/ after force-stopping the app.

LoginWaitTimeout.name: Login wait timeout
LoginWaitTimeout.help:
Maximum time (seconds) to wait for login/startup to complete after the game restarts.
Increase this if the game starts slowly when the emulator runs in the background, to avoid false stuck detection and restart loops.
Default 30 seconds; only affects the post-restart login wait phase.

MoveChannelFloat.name: Remove channel float window on startup
MoveChannelFloat.help:
Note: only the 4399 channel server is supported. Please move the floating ball to between the level badge and the player name at the top-left of the main page by yourself; the current detection range is the left half of the top edge.
When enabled, the login flow automatically performs the drag and hide a few seconds after the app starts.
This feature is still being improved; if the ball is not hidden successfully, please disable it for now.

Serial.name: Emulator serial
Serial.help:
Common emulator Serial can be found in the list below
Fill in "auto" to automatically detect the emulator. "auto" cannot be used when multiple emulators are running or an emulator that does not support automatic detection is used and must be filled in manually.

Emulator default Serial:
- BlueStacks 127.0.0.1:5555
- BlueStacks 4 Hyper-v version, fill in "bluestacks4-hyperv" to automatically connect, fill in "bluestacks4-hyperv-2" for more options, and so on.
- BlueStacks 5 Hyper-v version, fill in "bluestacks5-hyperv" to automatically connect, fill in "bluestacks5-hyperv-1" for more options, and so on.
- NoxPlayer 127.0.0.1:62001
- NoxPlayer 64-bit 127.0.0.1:59865
- MuMu Player/MuMu Player X 127.0.0.1:7555
- MuMu Player 12 127.0.0.1:16384
- MuMu Pro (macOS) 127.0.0.1:16384, the order of opening is 127.0.0.1:16416, 127.0.0.1:16448...
- MEmu 127.0.0.1:21503
- LDPlayer emulator-5554 or 127.0.0.1:5555
If you use the multi-instance function of the emulator, their Serial will not be the default. You can execute `adb devices` query in console.bat, or fill it in according to the official tutorial of the emulator.

PackageName.name: Game Server
PackageName.help: When multiple game clients are installed on the emulator, you need to manually select the server

ServerName.name: In-game server
ServerName.help:
Select the server where the game is located to enable server status detection
Suspend until resumed during server maintenance or network unavailability

ScreenshotMethod.name: Select screenshot method
ScreenshotMethod.help:
When using auto-select, a performance test will be performed and automatically changed to the fastest screenshot method
General speed: DroidCast_raw >> aScreenCap_nc > ADB_nc >>> aScreenCap > uiautomator2 ~= ADB
Run Tools - Performance Test to find the fastest method

ControlMethod.name: Select control method
ControlMethod.help:
Input injection method for clicks and swipes. Speed: minitouch ≈ MaaTouch > ADB >>> uiautomator2. Recommended: MaaTouch (minitouch can be unstable on newer Android devices).
⚠️ nemu_ipc must be paired with the nemu_ipc screenshot method (auto-paired at startup when screenshot is set to nemu_ipc). Caution: nemu_ipc touch injection goes through the emulator's internal RPC; on low-end PCs swipes may lose steps and drags may deform, and occasional hangs can drop clicks. Switch back to minitouch / MaaTouch if swiping misbehaves.

GameSettings.name: Automatically apply recommended game settings
GameSettings.help: Before starting the game, automatically attempt to apply the recommended frame-rate, story, Operation Siren, notification, and confirmation settings. It runs only when the game process has fully stopped, root or su access is available, and the write passes verification. Settings data is processed in memory only; no backup or recovery file is created. If it cannot run safely, it is skipped without affecting normal game startup.

ScreenshotDedithering.name: Remove image color dithering
ScreenshotDedithering.help: Enable when running on a real device

AdbRestart.name: Restart ADB when no device is detected

_info.name: Emulator settings
_info.help: The following values are automatically filled in based on Serial. If you do not understand, please do not modify it at will. Modifying the port will automatically start the corresponding instance.

EnableRemoteSSH.name: Enable remote SSH management
EnableRemoteSSH.help: Execute specific commands (e.g., restart Docker containers) on a remote server via SSH before restarting the emulator.

RemoteSSHHost.name: Remote server address
RemoteSSHHost.help: IP address or domain of the remote server, e.g., 192.168.1.100

RemoteSSHUser.name: SSH username
RemoteSSHUser.help: Username to login via SSH, e.g., root

RemoteSSHPublicKey.name: SSH private key
RemoteSSHPublicKey.help: The private key content for SSH authentication (if needed)

RemoteStartCommand.name: Remote start command
RemoteStartCommand.help: SSH command to start the emulator/service (e.g., docker start)

RemoteStopCommand.name: Remote stop command
RemoteStopCommand.help: SSH command to stop the emulator/service (e.g., docker stop)

HandleError.name: Enable exception handling
HandleError.help: Handle some exceptions and retreat when an error occurs.

SaveError.name: When an error occurs, save the log and screenshots

StrictRestart.name: Prohibit restarting when errors occur in sensitive tasks
StrictRestart.help: When an error occurs, directly terminate AzurPilot without restarting the game. Use for debugging, commission tasks, research tasks, Obscured Zones, Abyssal Zones, and other critical timing tasks

TaskRestartLimit.name: Consecutive restart limit per task
TaskRestartLimit.help: After this many consecutive failed recovery attempts, defer the task until the next server midnight and send an alert using error notification settings. Only success of that task resets its count; other tasks and successful game restarts do not. 0 = unlimited.

SaveErrorRetentionDays.name: Error log expiration (days)
SaveErrorRetentionDays.help:
Error scenes older than this are handled by the method below
0 = keep everything

OnePushConfig.name: Error push settings
OnePushConfig.help: Notification will be sent via OnePush when an error occurs. Configure the OnePush provider for use, refer to https://github.com/y1ndan/onepush

LowPushMode.name: Low Push Mode
LowPushMode.help: Only push errors that require manual intervention. Recoverable errors such as the game not running, the emulator being offline or the game being stuck are only logged, not pushed

ScreenshotLength.name: On error, keep the last X screenshots

GameStuckRestart.name: Restart the emulator when the game freezes
GameStuckRestart.help: After the game freezes (triggers GameStuckError) for the specified number of times, try restarting the emulator. It may help solve problems such as emulator freeze or memory overflow.

GameStuckThreshold.name: Restart when the game is stuck for X seconds
GameStuckThreshold.help: How many consecutive times it is stuck before triggering a restart.

AdbOfflineRestart.name: Restart the emulator when the device is not detected
AdbOfflineRestart.help: After the device cannot be detected continuously (ADB is offline or the connection fails) for the specified number of times, try to restart the emulator.

AdbOfflineThreshold.name: Restart when the device is unreachable for X seconds
AdbOfflineThreshold.help: The number of times the device cannot be detected in a row triggers a restart.

WatchdogEnable.name: Watchdog master switch
WatchdogEnable.help: What's a watchdog? It's a bodyguard running in the background. Turn it on to enable the checks below; turn it off and nothing below matters. Default off.

WatchdogTaskEnable.name: Auto-restart if task runs too long
WatchdogTaskEnable.help:
When enabled, if a task runs too long (e.g. stuck on an unskippable story, pathfinding loop), the emulator is force-restarted to break out of it.
Requires the master switch above to be on. Default off.

WatchdogTaskTimeout.name: How long before a task is considered stuck (min)
WatchdogTaskTimeout.help:
How many minutes a task can run before it's considered stuck. If exceeded, the emulator is force-restarted.
0 = never trigger; 99999 = basically never.
Default 120 min (2 hours).

RestartOperationTimeoutEnable.name: Game restart timeout protection
RestartOperationTimeoutEnable.help:
When enabled, if a step during game restart (stopping/starting the game) gets stuck for longer than the timeout below, the emulator is considered dead and gets restarted.
When disabled, this check is skipped.
Default off.

RestartOperationTimeout.name: How long before game restart is considered stuck (sec)
RestartOperationTimeout.help:
During game restart, if stopping or starting the game is stuck for longer than this many seconds, the emulator is considered dead and gets restarted.
Requires 'Game restart timeout protection' above to be on.
Default 120 sec.

LlmAnalysis.name: Enable LLM error analysis
LlmAnalysis.help: Automatically use LLM to analyze errors when they occur.

LlmApiKey.name: LLM API key
LlmApiKey.help: Purchase model service and get an API key from https://platform.deepseek.com/ or https://platform.xiaomimimo.com/.

LlmApiBase.name: LLM API base
LlmApiBase.help: Enter the provider's OpenAI-compatible Base URL. Refer to https://platform.deepseek.com/ or https://platform.xiaomimimo.com/ for setup instructions.

LlmModel.name: LLM model
LlmModel.help: Enter a model name supported by your purchased service, as shown on https://platform.deepseek.com/ or https://platform.xiaomimimo.com/.

_info.name: Daily summary
_info.help: Generate and push a daily automation summary at the configured time. Configure OnePush and LLM settings in Debug Settings first.

Enable.name: Enable daily summary
Enable.help: When enabled, AzurPilot generates and pushes the daily automation summary at the configured time.

TriggerTime.name: Generation time
TriggerTime.help: Time to generate the report in the game server time zone. Use HH:MM, for example 20:00.

OcrDevice.name: OCR device
OcrDevice.help:
Choose the OCR inference device.
Auto on Windows tries QNN NPU, OpenVINO NPU, OpenVINO discrete GPU, DirectML discrete GPU, OpenVINO CPU, then CPU. Disabling Auto-install and use vendor EPs limits Windows to DirectML discrete GPU and CPU.
QNN/OpenVINO devices require ONNX Runtime. ANE is only for Apple Silicon Macs.

OcrBackend.name: OCR backend
OcrBackend.help: Choose the OCR inference engine. ONNX Runtime uses the ONNX Runtime backend, ncnn uses the ncnn Vulkan backend. Auto defaults to ONNX Runtime.

OcrWindowsMlVendorEp.name: Auto-install and use vendor EPs
OcrWindowsMlVendorEp.help: Allow Windows ML to download and use QNN/OpenVINO execution providers through Windows Update.

OcrModelVersionEnglish.name: OCR English model version
OcrModelVersionEnglish.help: Choose the English OCR model tier. Lite is lightest and fastest, Standard is balanced, Pro is highest accuracy. Auto uses the legacy alocr_en_v2_6 model. alocr_en_v2_6 is available only with the ONNX backend. This affects the English Azur Lane model.

OcrModelVersionChinese.name: OCR Chinese model version
OcrModelVersionChinese.help: Choose the Simplified Chinese OCR model tier. Lite is lightest and fastest, Standard is balanced, Pro is highest accuracy. Auto uses the legacy alocr_cn_v3 model. alocr_cn_v3 is available only with the ONNX backend. This affects cnocr/Chinese models.

OcrModelVersionJapanese.name: OCR Japanese model version
OcrModelVersionJapanese.help: Choose the Japanese OCR model tier. Lite is lightest and fastest but does not support Japanese, Standard is balanced, Pro is highest accuracy. Auto uses Standard. This affects Japanese models.

OcrModelVersionTraditionalChinese.name: OCR Traditional Chinese model version
OcrModelVersionTraditionalChinese.help: Choose the Traditional Chinese OCR model tier. Lite is lightest and fastest, Standard is balanced, Pro is highest accuracy. Auto uses Standard.

ScreenshotInterval.name: Slow down screenshot speed to X seconds per frame
ScreenshotInterval.help: Minimum interval between two screenshots, limited to 0.001 ~ 0.3. Can reduce CPU usage on high-spec computers.

CombatScreenshotInterval.name: Slow down combat screenshot speed to X seconds per frame
CombatScreenshotInterval.help: Minimum interval between two screenshots, limited to 0.001 ~ 1.0. Can reduce CPU usage during combat.

TaskHoardingDuration.name: Hoard tasks for X minutes
TaskHoardingDuration.help:
Can reduce the frequency of game operations during reward collection
After a task is triggered, wait X minutes, then execute all hoarded tasks at once

CloseEmulatorDuringLongWait.name: Close the emulator during long waits
CloseEmulatorDuringLongWait.help: When the next task is more than 3 hours away, close the emulator during the wait to save memory and CPU.

WhenTaskQueueEmpty.name: When the task queue is empty
WhenTaskQueueEmpty.help: Closing the game when there are no tasks can reduce CPU usage during reward collection

WhenSchedulerStopped.name: After stopping the scheduler
WhenSchedulerStopped.help: Action to perform after stopping the scheduler from the WebUI

WarmupEnable.name: Start the emulator and game before the next task
WarmupEnable.help: When the emulator/game was closed during a wait (emulator closed on a long wait, or game closed when the task queue is empty), start the emulator and game and log in before the next task begins, so the task runs on time instead of a cold start at task time. While enabled, waits shorter than the lead time no longer close the game.

WarmupMinutes.name: Start the emulator and game X minutes before the task
WarmupMinutes.help: How many minutes before the task the warm-up launch begins; used until a measured startup time exists. After each successful warm-up the actual startup time is recorded, and later warm-ups launch by 'last measured + 2 minutes', so the game is ready about 2 minutes before the task.

RetentionDays.name: Screenshot retention (days)
RetentionDays.help:
Drop record screenshots older than this many days are handled by the method below
0 = no day-based cleanup (commission reward screenshots still keep the latest 50 only)

BackUpMethod.name: Expired screenshot processing method
BackUpMethod.help: The backup directory is the bak folder under the save directory (for commission rewards, under each instance folder)

OpsiHazard1Leveling.name: Corrosion 1 drop screenshot
OpsiHazard1Leveling.help: Corrosion 1 leveling is not counted here (its profit is on the "Operation Siren summary" page); Save only keeps the screenshot, Upload does nothing

OpsiDaily.help:

Its own switch for Monthly Exploration, not shared with other tasks

OpsiOther.name: Other Operation Siren drop screenshot
OpsiOther.help:
Fallback for Operation Siren tasks without a switch of their own

TelemetryReport.name: Telemetry data reporting
TelemetryReport.help: After being enabled, CL1 statistics (anonymous data such as the number of battles and Akashi encounter probability) will be reported anonymously to the server on a regular basis. KeepDays.name: Backup retention (days)
KeepDays.help: Backups older than this many days are deleted after each backup completes. For example, 7 keeps only the most recent 7 days.

_info.help: Only takes effect when "Retirement Mode" is set to "Quick Retire"

KeepLimitBreak.help:
When there are no ships of the same name with full stars, several ships of the same name that meet the conditions for retirement will be retained.

UseHandoverBook.help: Max out the invested Handover Books before starting

ConsumeAllBook.help:
Triggered once a week: max out Sorties → max out Handover Books → set Sorties to the number of books,
so the whole stock of books is spent at once.
On the trigger day the Count option is ignored; with Count set to 0 the task only runs at the trigger time

ConsumeAllBookWeekday.help: Trigger once a week on this day

ConsumeAllBookTime.help: Trigger at or after this time on the trigger day, format HH:MM, e.g. 12:00

MaintainOverride.name: Handover before maintenance
MaintainOverride.help:
Check the maintenance notice once a day. If the maintenance is today and has not started yet, this run is
postponed to 10 minutes before it and then runs with max sorties (still respecting Use Handover Book and
auto-supplement time). Past or non-today maintenance is ignored.
Data from api-blhx-maintain, fetched for your game server and converted to local time

OilLimit.help:
Postpone the task while oil is below this value, resume when oil is enough
0 to disable

When the Handover Books were last consumed.
If it falls in the current week, the weekly consume will not trigger again.
Clear it or set it to last week or earlier to let it run again this week

CommissionEnd.help: Recorded by the script when starting a commission, used to know when to collect the reward

OilLimit.help: Delay the task when oil is too low, continue sortie when oil is sufficient

OilLimitHardFloor.help: Actual stop threshold is max(floor, oil limit). 500 is a legacy safety net; lower it if you run low-cost maps and want to drain oil further. Set 0 to make oil limit take effect directly

CoinLimit.help:

Each run decreases the count by one, task stops when it reaches zero

MapAchievement.help:
Achieve 100% map clear, achieve 3-star clear, achieve safe sea area,
or achieve safe sea area without getting 3 stars then stop

StageIncrease.name: Auto-progress after achieving map completion
StageIncrease.help:
Automatically progresses to next stage. Ensure your fleet is strong enough and meets stage attribute requirements. Set "Stop After Achieving Map Completion" accordingly.
For example, turn on this option and select "100% Clear", it will proceed to the next stage after 100% completion.
Supported maps: 1-1 to 15-4, A1 to A3, B1 to B3, C1 to C3, D1 to D3, T1 to T6, SP1 to SP4

ReachLevel.help:
Any ship below level X will stop after reaching level X
0 means no level restriction

DailyRunCount.name: Sortie X times daily
DailyRunCount.help:
Maximum War Archives runs per day.
0 means no limit.
After reaching the limit, the task is delayed until the next server reset instead of being disabled.

AutoClear.name: Auto clear
AutoClear.help:
Automatically clear all stages of the event.
Stage name can be left blank; the script decides which stage to run
according to the clear target. Finished stages are skipped.
Normal Maps 3 Stars / All Maps 3 Stars mode: auto search for the 2nd star,
full clear for the 3rd.
100% Clear mode: full-clear runs only; intermediate stages advance once 100% cleared.

AutoSelectEvent.name: Auto select event
AutoSelectEvent.help:
When enabled, the event name input is ignored.
The script selects war archive events from top to bottom and clears them one by one;
when an event is fully cleared, the next one starts automatically.
Requires Auto Clear.

AutoClearTarget.name: Clear target
AutoClearTarget.help:
Scope and strategy of auto clear:
Normal Maps 3 Stars: farms every stage of the normal map to 3 stars
(auto search for the 2nd star, full clear for the 3rd), stops when done.
All Maps 3 Stars: farms every stage of both normal and hard maps to 3 stars
(auto search for the 2nd star, full clear for the 3rd);
normal maps are cleared before hard maps.
100% Clear: full-clears hard stages; intermediate stages advance once 100% cleared
(one full-clear run each), only the last stage is farmed to full stars.
Stage name is decided by the script automatically.

AutoClearProgress.name: Auto clear progress
AutoClearProgress.help: Auto clear progress recorded by the script, so finished stages are skipped on the next run.

DailyRunCountRemain.name: Daily sorties remaining
DailyRunCountRemain.help: Today's remaining quota, maintained automatically by the script.

DailyRunCountRecord.name: Daily sortie count record time
DailyRunCountRecord.help: Quota record time maintained automatically by the script, used to reset after server refresh.

DailyRunCountLimit.name: Previous daily sortie count
DailyRunCountLimit.help: Previous daily count setting maintained automatically by the script, used when adjusting the quota.

Fleet1Step.name: Fleet 1 step size
Fleet1Step.help: Limit movement distance in event maps

Fleet2Step.name: Fleet 2 step size
Fleet2Step.help: Limit movement distance in event maps

FleetOrder.name: Fleet role
FleetOrder.help:
Without auto-search, will pick up question marks and ammo.
When fighting 4 battles or fewer without auto-search, uses "one fleet clears, other fleet on standby".

SkipPreparation.name: Skip fleet preparation
SkipPreparation.help:
When enabled, skips the fleet selection step in the preparation screen and directly uses the currently pre-selected fleet for sortie
Suitable for accounts with unlocked fleet slots, to avoid dropdown detection getting stuck
Before enabling, make sure Fleet 1 and Fleet 2 are manually selected in-game

Mode.name: Select submarine sortie plan
Mode.help:
Only takes effect when auto-search is off. Note: 'Hunt and Boss' combines 'Hunt Only' and 'Boss Only' - submarines will hunt during mob battles and be summoned during boss battles.
Note: Calling the submarine at the BOSS node requires the default battle UI theme, otherwise it will not be called.

AutoSearchMode.name: Select submarine auto plan
AutoSearchMode.help: Applies to auto search sorties. With manual enemy search and "standby", in-game sub auto call is also turned off before entering (cleared maps only; the setting page does not exist on uncleared maps)

DistanceToBoss.name: Move submarine near the boss before the boss battle
DistanceToBoss.help:
Only takes effect when "Submarine Attack Mode" is "Boss Only" or "Hunt and Boss"
Selecting "X tiles from Boss" requires ensuring the submarine hunting range covers the Boss. Distance is calculated using Manhattan distance. Selecting "Use Open Ocean Support" requires U-522/Da Vinci in the submarine fleet.

AdvancedConfig.name: Advanced config
AdvancedConfig.help:
The advanced config takes effect only when the Submarine Sortie Plan is set to "Advanced". The configuration must strictly follow the YAML format.

[Basic parameters]
- ammo: Total ammunition of the submarine.
- support: Number of Open Ocean Support uses available.
- range: Hunting range, composed of 7 strings of length 7. "N" means covered; "O" means not covered; "H" is the submarine position, which only appears at row 4 column 4 (center).

[Rules]
- Battle index: battle_0 (all battles), battle_N (the Nth battle, 1-based), battle_-N (the Nth from the end). If a battle matches multiple rules, the sortie order is "summon > hunt > don't sortie".
- type: Sortie type. hunt, call.
- condition: Trigger condition (sortie unconditionally if omitted).
    ammo: Ammo condition expression, e.g. ">2", ">=2", "=3". Supported operators: ">", ">=", "<", "<=", "=", "!=".
    support: Open Ocean Support count condition expression, e.g. ">2", ">=2", "=3". Supported operators: ">", ">=", "<", "<=", "=", "!=".
    enemy: Target enemy fleet type list, expressed as scale + class. E.g. "3M" means a large main fleet. Wildcard "*" is supported, e.g. "3*" means all large fleets, "*T" means all transports.
    - Scale: 1: small fleet; 2: medium fleet; 3: large fleet; 0: unknown scale.
    - Class: L: scout fleet; M: main fleet; C: aircraft carrier fleet; T: transport; E: unknown type.
    in_range (true/false): Whether the submarine is within hunting range. Summoning outside the hunting range consumes Open Ocean Support uses.
- move: Whether to spend oil to move the submarine to the cheapest fuel position covering the target when out of range (true/false). If Open Ocean Support uses remain, it won't move and will use Open Ocean Support instead.

Mode.name: Morale mode
Mode.calculate_ignore: Calculate morale + ignore low morale warning

IgnoreShipwreck.name: Ignore shipwreck morale penalty
IgnoreShipwreck.help: When enabled, the extra 10 morale penalty for sinking ships in battle (non-S rating) is no longer counted. Only effective when the morale mode includes "Calculate morale consumption".

Fleet1Onsen.name: All Fleet 1 members have a hot spring (+10/h)

Fleet2Onsen.name: All Fleet 2 members have a hot spring (+10/h)

UseHpBalance.name: Enable HP balance
UseHpBalance.help: Move ships with low HP to protected positions, and ships with high HP to damage-taking positions.

HpBalanceWeight.name: Vanguard HP weight

Modify if there are differences in vanguard tankiness. Format:
1000, 1000, 1000

RepairUseSingleThreshold.name: Use emergency repair when any ship's HP falls below X

RepairUseMultiThreshold.name: Use emergency repair when all ships' HP fall below X

LowHpRetreatThreshold.name: When the HP of any ship falls below X, retreat

_info.name: Enemy priority
_info.help: Customize the priority of enemies to fight

EnemyScaleBalanceWeight.name: Enemy priority
EnemyScaleBalanceWeight.help: First clear enemies on the main route to Boss, then clear others by priority.

_info.name: 7-2 3-Battle Mystery Farming
_info.help: Fight three battles, then retreat after collecting mystery nodes

StepOnA3.name: Use Fleet 2 to step on A3
StepOnA3.help: Can effectively prevent A2's mystery node from being blocked.
