_info.help:
Use a low-power fleet to level up at 12-2, retreat after defeating non-3-star enemies.
Increase EXP/oil ratio by reducing fleet power

_info.name: 12-4 Large Leveling
_info.help:
Use a strong fleet to level up at 12-4, retreat after defeating 3-star enemies.
Increase EXP/oil ratio by defeating more 3-star enemies

NonLargeEnterTolerance.name: After entering the map, retreat if X consecutive battles have no three-star enemies

NonLargeRetreatTolerance.name: Fight up to X non-three-star enemies

PickupAmmo.name: Pick up ammo after X battles

_info.name: Urgent Commission Farming
_info.help:
Warning: This feature allows players to earn a small amount of Gems, but it is not an efficient way to farm Gems
New Azur Lane players often overvalue limit break avoidance and low oil cost, while neglecting ship development
Running this feature only makes you feel productive, while your account actually makes zero progress
Please press the return button

EventFallbackStage.name: Stage after event
EventFallbackStage.help: When the event PT limit or time limit is reached, or the event is unavailable, continue on this main campaign stage. Default: 2-4. Enter 0 to disable the task and keep the event stage. Only applies to tasks currently farming an event stage.

ChangeFlagship.name: Change flagship
ChangeFlagship.help:
White-rarity light carriers and white-rarity carriers will be treated as retirement targets
Only 0 limit break, no equipment, white-rarity light carriers will be used as replacement
Controls: When to replace the flagship

CommonCVFilter.name: Custom flagship carrier filter
CommonCVFilter.help:
Filter usable light carriers, syntax same as common CV filter
Separated by spaces, case-insensitive
Example: bogue: Bogue, ranger: Ranger, langley: Langley, hermes: Hermes

ChangeVanguard.name: Change vanguard
ChangeVanguard.help:
Replace vanguard with low-oil-cost ships from Eagle Union or Iron Blood
Only 0 limit break, no equipment, white-rarity destroyers will be used as replacement
Controls: When to replace the vanguard

CommonDDFilter.name: Custom front row filter
CommonDDFilter.help:
Filter usable low-oil-cost vanguard ships
Separate by spaces
foote: Foote, cassin: Cassin, downes: Downes

EquipmentCode.name: Equipment code
EquipmentCode.help:
Default equipment code for light carriers
Separate by spaces
bogue: Bogue, hermes: Hermes, langley: Langley, ranger: Ranger

UseEmotionFirst.name: Prioritize morale
UseEmotionFirst.help: When replacing ships, prioritize the highest mood ships.

IgnoreEmotionWarning.name: Ignore low morale warning
IgnoreEmotionWarning.help: Force through the mood warning popup when it appears.

AllowHighFlagshipLevel.name: Only replace max-level back row
AllowHighFlagshipLevel.help:
When the flagship has a replacement and its level is higher than the vanguard
Use white-rarity light carriers in the back row to consume oil and earn experience
If the back row has other ships, this function will not be used
Please manually add ships that need leveling

AllowLowVanguardLevel.name: Allow low-level vanguard replacement
AllowLowVanguardLevel.help: After enabling, the front row level limit is changed to level 30 or above. If it is hard mode (such as the CD map), it is changed to level 70.

DelayTaskIFNoFlagship.name: Delay task when no suitable replacement ship is available
DelayTaskIFNoFlagship.help: On: postpone the task when no replacement ship meets the level and other requirements. Off: continue sorties with the current fleet and retry replacement after battle. Low morale or errors during ship replacement or equipment transfer still interrupt the task.

CommissionLimit.name: Prevent too many urgent commissions
CommissionLimit.help: When enabled, commission scheduling reserves high-value commissions according to the following settings and delays urgent-commission farming when the reserve threshold is reached.

HighValueCommissionFilterCount.name: High-value commission filter count
HighValueCommissionFilterCount.help: Treat the first X regular rules in the active commission filter as high-value rules. Control markers such as tier and shortest are not counted.

HighValueCommissionReserve.name: High-value commission reserve
HighValueCommissionReserve.help: After starting commissions, delay urgent-commission farming when the number of pending commissions matching high-value rules reaches this value.

VanguardLevelMin.name: Vanguard minimum level
VanguardLevelMin.help: Used to filter eligible white-rarity vanguard ships. Default is 1.

VanguardLevelMax.name: Vanguard maximum level
VanguardLevelMax.help: Used to filter eligible white-rarity vanguard ships. Default is 125.

PtLimit.name: Stop when event PT reaches X
PtLimit.help:
When accumulated PT reaches the given value, all event tasks are disabled. 0 means no limit. Cannot trigger immediately when using auto-search.
After enabling, you only need to open all event tasks without counting total runs.
Gems farming and Three-oil low-cost farming follow their own Stage after event setting: continue on a main campaign stage, or stop if set to 0.

TimeLimit.name: Event time limit
TimeLimit.help:
When local time exceeds the given value, all event tasks are disabled. '2023-01-01 00:00:00' means no limit. Timer resets after triggering once.
After setting, prevents forgetting to close tasks after an event ends.
Gems farming and Three-oil low-cost farming follow their own Stage after event setting: continue on a main campaign stage, or stop if set to 0.

_info.name: Task balance settings
_info.help: Prevent coins from being too low when running event maps

Enable.name: Enable task balancing
Enable.help: When enabled, coin amount will be checked after each sortie

TaskCall.name: Call task X when coins are low
TaskCall.help: Note: Players need to set up the called task in advance, otherwise it won't work

LastStage.name: Last completed stage
LastStage.help: Automatically updated value that skips completed stages in the filter, resets after midnight.

_info.name: Raid daily
_info.help: Complete daily Raid on Easy, Normal, and Hard difficulties

UseRecommendFleet.name: Use fleet recommendations
UseRecommendFleet.help: If turned off, you need to manually team up all 15 levels in advance

_info.name: Trade convoy
_info.help: Enter and immediately retreat, can earn about 70% of the rewards

_info.name: Coalition settings
_info.help: Teams must be manually allocated in the game before going out.

Mode.name: Difficulty
Mode.help: SP map requires running the daily SP mission first

_info.name: Coalition scuttle
_info.help: Coalition event scuttle settings. Select the position of ships to be sunk.

Sacrifice.name: Sacrificial ship position
Sacrifice.help: Select the position of ships to be sunk: Vanguard, Flagship, or Vanguard + Flagship

CustomFilter.name: Custom filter
CustomFilter.help: To use a custom filter, set "Event Shop Filter" to "Custom" and read https://github.com/LmeSzinc/AzurLaneAutoScript/wiki/filter_string_cn

_info.name: Advanced shop strategy
_info.help: Generate a shop purchase plan with restricted Lua-style rules.

Mode.name: Strategy mode
Mode.help: Simple mode keeps the existing filter. Advanced mode uses the strategy script below.

Script.name: Strategy script
Script.help: Only restricted Lua-style rules are supported. A validation error skips purchases for this run.

PresetFilter.name: Commission filter
PresetFilter.help: Select a preset commission filter or enter a custom filter
PresetFilter.chip_24h: Diamond > Cognitive Chips > Cubes (7x24 Commission Farming)

DynamicProgramming.name: Experimental dynamic programming
DynamicProgramming.help: When disabled, commissions are selected greedily in filter order. Enable it to use the polynomial planner with a rigorous optimality certificate and the five value-model settings below.

TierValueRatio.name: Adjacent tier value ratio
TierValueRatio.help: Base-value ratio between one tier and the next; must be greater than 1. Higher values make the planner less willing to delay a higher tier for a lower tier. Default: 2.

DelayHalfLife.name: Base delay half-life (hours)
DelayHalfLife.help: H in the unified factor 2^(-s/H). Lower values apply a stronger base delay penalty to every commission. Must be positive; one decimal place is supported.

DeadlineFutureHorizon.name: Deadline discount scale (hours)
DeadlineFutureHorizon.help: T in the unified relative-window exponent (T/d)^2. Larger values impose a stronger penalty for the same start delay and deadline. Must be positive; one decimal place is supported. Default: 2.0 hours.

FilterValueFloor.name: In-tier filter value floor
FilterValueFloor.help: Minimum value fraction retained by very late rules within one tier. Range: greater than 0 and at most 1. Lower values make in-tier order matter more. Default: 0.6.

FilterValueHalfLife.name: In-tier index half-life
FilterValueHalfLife.help: Number of filter rules required for the in-tier adjustment to move halfway toward its floor; must be positive and may use one decimal place. Lower values concentrate more value in early rules.

CustomFilter.name: Custom commission filter
CustomFilter.help: Set Commission Filter to Customize to use this filter. With experimental dynamic programming enabled, tier separates value levels; without tier, every rule becomes its own level. The planner discounts finite tier and in-tier values by expected start delay and may drop low-value commissions. The traditional greedy strategy ignores tier; shortest fills unmatched slots.

Blacklist.name: Commission blacklist
Blacklist.help: Enter commission filter rules to ignore, separated by half-width commas (,), for example: ExtraBook, UrgentOil-8, Major. The blacklist applies to both the traditional greedy strategy and the planner.

DoMajorCommission.name: Run major commissions (1200/1000 oil)
DoMajorCommission.help: The 1200 oil commission is now obsolete and the yield is very low. It is recommended to disable it.

CommissionNotifyReward.name: Commission reward push notification
CommissionNotifyReward.help: Push notification when receiving commission rewards (especially for gems)

CommissionNotifyRewardStatistics.name: Include statistics in push
CommissionNotifyRewardStatistics.help: Display today/week/month cumulative gem count in notification

DetectShipDrop.name: Detect ship drop
DetectShipDrop.help: Detect and close the ship obtained popup after claiming commission rewards. Disable if you do not run ship-dropping commissions to avoid detection errors.

GemNotify.name: Gem commission execution notification
GemNotify.help: After a new Gem Commission starts, send the list of all currently running Gem Commissions

GemStatistics.name: Gem commission statistics details
GemStatistics.help: When enabled, include gem commission statistics (success rate, total rewards) in reward notification

GemStatisticsPeriod.name: Gem commission statistics period
GemStatisticsPeriod.help: Statistical period for gem commission rewards

RapidTrainingSlot.name: Use quick learning
RapidTrainingSlot.help: During the event, there are 10 quick skill learning sessions per day

SkillAutoSwitch.name: Auto switch skill
SkillAutoSwitch.help: Automatically switch to the next unlearned skill for training

_info.name: Overflow EXP control
_info.help:
Prevent the use of advanced skill books from overflowing a large amount of experience when skills are almost at full level.
For example, if the T3 book overflows by 100 points and the T4 book overflows by 100 points, when there are 1100 experience points left, the T4 book will not be used and the T3 book will be used instead.

T4Allow.name: Allow T4 skill book to overflow X EXP

T3Allow.name: Allow T3 skill book to overflow X EXP

T2Allow.name: Allow T2 skill book to overflow X EXP

T1Allow.name: Allow T1 skill book to overflow X EXP

_info.name: Learn new skills
_info.help: When there is a vacant position in the Tactics Academy, a ship girl will be automatically assigned and will learn the first skill that is not yet full level.

Favorite.name: Only favorite ships
Favorite.help:
During student selection apply the favorite filter
Thereby, giving priority to certain ship girls
Apply the favorite status to a ship girl in-game

MinLevel.name: Only add ships at level >= X

MaxLevel.name: Only add ships at level <= X
MaxLevel.help:
0 means no limit
When it conflicts with the minimum level, both are treated as 0 (disabled)

_info.name: Research lab
_info.help:
When filters work with other settings, AzurPilot looks for items that satisfy all user settings simultaneously.
For example, if you set the research filter to `H1 > D2.5 > shortest` (including research that consumes cubes), but also set it not to allow cube consumption, the final result is that AzurPilot will not select research that consumes cubes. When you suddenly want to use cubes, you only need to enable cube consumption without modifying the filter, which is more convenient.

AllowDelay.name: Delay research when resources are insufficient
AllowDelay.help:
When resources are insufficient, AzurPilot will delay research until conditions are met or the research queue is about to be cleared, which will not cause research to stop.
If resources remain insufficient for a long time or AzurPilot is not running long enough, you can disable this option to keep the research queue full.

AllowGenreT.name: Allow T-series research
AllowGenreT.help: T-series research may leave the research queue idle and reduce efficiency. Enable it only when needed.

RemainingCommissions.name: Remaining T-series commissions
RemainingCommissions.help: Number of commissions still required by the pending T-series research. -1 means no T-series research is pending.

PresetFilter.name: Research filter
PresetFilter.help: For research drops and project refreshes, please see https://azur-stats.lyoko.io/. People who do not have a basic understanding of these are not recommended to write custom filters. It is recommended to use pre-optimized research filters.

CustomFilter.name: Custom research filters
CustomFilter.help: To use a custom filter, you need to set "Research Filter" to "Custom" and read https://github.com/LmeSzinc/AzurLaneAutoScript/wiki/filter_string_cn

BuyFood.name: Automatically purchase food
BuyFood.help: For status display only. Disable setting. Do not ask anything about this switch.

_info.name: Event furniture setup
_info.help: Purchase limited-time furniture from the Dorm furniture shop during events

BuyOption.name: Purchase option
BuyOption.help:
Buy a set: buy one of each furniture piece; Buy all: buy all furniture up to the limit. Both options will remove the furniture set from the front of the furniture shop. If you buy a set, remaining furniture needs to be purchased manually.
There is not much difference in furniture cost between the two options, so buying all is recommended. Will not buy diamond furniture

LastRun.name: Last check time
LastRun.help: Record the time of the last check to prevent the task from running repeatedly. The check interval is 6 days. This value is automatically recorded and generally does not need to be modified.

BuyAmount.name: Buy X meowfficer boxes daily
BuyAmount.help: The first cat box of the day is free

Mode.name: Select training mode
Mode.help:
Seamless Meowfficer Training will collect Meowfficers every 2.5 ~ 3.5 hours.
Collect one per day means collect one every day, collect all on Sunday, enhance and refill the queue to complete weekly missions

RetainTalentedGold.name: Lock golden Meowfficers with special talents
RetainTalentedGold.help: Lock Meowfficers with special talents when collecting. Locked Meowfficers will not be used for enhancement. Users need to manually check and unlock unnecessary ones.

RetainTalentedPurple.name: Lock purple Meowfficers with special talents
RetainTalentedPurple.help: Lock Meowfficers with special talents when collecting. Locked Meowfficers will not be used for enhancement. Users need to manually check and unlock unnecessary ones.

ScoreTalents.name: Score talents while collecting
ScoreTalents.help: Also identify talent names and score them with public guide rules when collecting meowfficers; opens every talent detail, a bit slower

ScoreThreshold.name: Score threshold to keep
ScoreThreshold.help: 0 disables the check; when greater than 0, cats scoring below it are not locked (only when scoring is enabled)

EnhanceIndex.name: Use Meowfficers without special talents to enhance the Xth Meowfficer
EnhanceIndex.help: The Xth Meowfficer in the Meowfficer storage, limited to 1 ~ 12, in order from upper left to lower right

MaxFeedLevel.name: Do not use Meowfficers above level X as enhancement material

Enable.name: Enable guild logistics
Enable.help: Receive guild missions, submit preparation materials, and receive fleet rewards

SelectNewMission.name: Select new weekly fleet mission
SelectNewMission.help:
This account needs to be the fleet commander or deputy commander to enable.
By default, Siren Annihilation III, which is the easiest to complete, is selected. The mission is to sink 300 enemy ships.

ExchangeFilter.name: Preparation item filter
ExchangeFilter.help: Generally no modification is needed, prioritize the one with the least consumption

SelectNewOperation.name: Start a new guild operation
SelectNewOperation.help:
This account needs to be the fleet commander or deputy commander to enable.
By default, the Guadalcanal Island Sea and Air Battle with the most rewards is selected.

NewOperationMaxDate.name: After the Xth day of each month, no new guild operations will be started
NewOperationMaxDate.help:
Only takes effect when "Start a new Guild Operation" is enabled.
It is not recommended to start three Guild Operations per month, because each player can only participate twice a month, and most members cannot participate in the dispatch of the third operation. This will affect the evaluation of dispatch events, resulting in reduced final rewards.

JoinThreshold.name: Only join a guild operation when progress > X
JoinThreshold.help: 0.0 ~ 1.0. For example, '0.5' means to join only when the combat progress is less than half, and '1' means to join directly regardless of the progress.

BossFleetRecommend.name: Use recommended fleet to attack BOSS
BossFleetRecommend.help: Recommended to disable and set up your own fleet

_info.name: Cognitive Awakening
_info.help: Cognitive Awaken all ships in the dock until Cognitive Chips are exhausted

_info.name: Secretary settings
_info.help: Configure automatic secretary replacement and notification settings

CustomFilter.name: Rarity filter
CustomFilter.help:
Rarities include ultra, super_rare, elite, rare, and common
Please enter the custom order below
Default priority: ultra > super_rare > elite > rare > common

LowFavorabilityPriority.name: Low favorability priority
LowFavorabilityPriority.help: Ships will be selected in ascending order of favorability

FavouriteOnly.name: Only pick from favorited ships
FavouriteOnly.help: When enabled, only ships marked as favourite in the dock are picked as secretary. Disable it to pick from all ships by rarity and favorability

BackupEnable.name: Backup secretary
BackupEnable.help: Use ships in the secretary group as backup secretaries and prioritize switching to them

CheckInterval.name: Custom check interval (hours)
CheckInterval.help: Check after the specified interval following a secretary switch. Set to 0 to calculate automatically based on affinity. If your secretary gains affinity through sorties, setting this value allows earlier replacement

OnePushConfig.name: OnePush configuration
OnePushConfig.help: Notification settings for secretary replacement. Leave empty to use the global configuration

Enable.name: Shop toggle
Enable.help: Enable this to run the shop. Disable it to skip this shop during the task.

BuySkinBox.name: Buy skin equipment box
BuySkinBox.help: To reduce maintenance costs, the appearance box selector in the filter will not be updated with the game, but AzurPilot will treat any unknown item with a quantity of 1 and consuming 7000 supplies as an appearance box and purchase it.

ConsumeCoins.name: Spend overflowing coins
ConsumeCoins.help: When coins exceed the limit, auto-purchase items from the Arms Dealer. Stops when coins drop below the limit

OverflowCoins.name: Buy meowfficer boxes on coin overflow
OverflowCoins.help: Automatically buy meowfficer boxes when coins exceed the threshold. 0 means disabled. Range: 1-600000

Enable.name: Shop toggle
Enable.help: Enable this to run the shop. Disable it to skip this shop during the task.

Refresh.name: Refresh shop
Refresh.help: Refreshing costs 50 Guild coins. Guild coins are not very valuable, it is recommended to enable.

Enable.name: Shop toggle
Enable.help: Enable this to run the shop. Disable it to skip this shop during the task.

Enable.name: Shop toggle
Enable.help: Enable this to run the shop. Disable it to skip this shop during the task.

BuyUnobtainedShip.name: Buy unobtained ships
BuyUnobtainedShip.help: Prioritizes ships marked as unobtained in the upper-right corner, regardless of the normal shop filter

Enable.name: Shop toggle
Enable.help: Enable this to run the shop. Disable it to skip this shop during the task.

_info.name: Rainbow Research blueprint purchase settings
_info.help: Buy Rainbow Research blueprints every day. Rainbow and Gold Research blueprint discounts are counted independently, and you can get 2 of each for free every day.

ShipIndex.name: Select research ship X
ShipIndex.help: Counting from left to right, starting from 1

BuyAmount.name: Purchase amount
BuyAmount.help: The first two blueprints every day are free

LastRun.name: Last purchase time
LastRun.help: Because the game does not display how many blueprints have been purchased today, the time of the last purchase is recorded here to prevent the task from running repeatedly. This value is automatically recorded and generally does not need to be modified.

ShipIndex.name: Select research ship X
ShipIndex.help: Counting from left to right, starting from 1

BuyAmount.name: Purchase quantity
BuyAmount.help: The first two tickets every day are free

LastRun.name: Last purchase time
LastRun.help: Because the game does not display how many tickets have been purchased today, the time of the last purchase is recorded here to prevent the task from running repeatedly. This value is automatically recorded and generally does not need to be modified.

_info.name: Daily build
_info.help: Build ships to complete daily missions. Building once in the Light Build Pool daily saves 200 Coins.

UseTicket.name: Use single build permit
UseTicket.help: When enabled, pools that support build permits will use them first. When no permits are available or building in a standard pool, Cubes will be used instead.

UseDrill.name: Use quick finisher to complete build
UseDrill.help: If set to No, will wait until tomorrow to launch. Use this to save Quick Finishers

ForceCollect.name: Force collect data key
ForceCollect.help: When Data Keys are full, force collect (remove the red dot)

DayOfWeek.name: Extend to which day of the week
DayOfWeek.help: It is recommended to set it to weekdays (Monday to Friday) to avoid missing purchases

BuyRoses.name: Buy weekly roses
BuyRoses.help:
The number of rose purchases is reset every Monday.
Each run will try to purchase them all at once. If Coins are insufficient (less than 24K), the purchase will be canceled and postponed to the next day.

BuyCake.name: Buy weekly cake gift box
BuyCake.help:
The number of cake gift box purchases resets every Monday.
Each run will try to purchase them all at once. If gems are insufficient (less than 210 gems), the purchase will be canceled and postponed to the next day.

TargetInteract.name: Clear daily energy
TargetInteract.help: Interact with the selected ship to clear today’s energy

TargetShip.name: Choose a ship to interact with daily
TargetShip.help: Choose the ship you want to interact with on a daily basis

UseDailySkip.name: Use quick challenge
UseDailySkip.help: After getting S rank on the daily stage, sweep is unlocked. If not unlocked, it will automatically fall back to the traditional sortie.

SupplyLineDisruption.name: Supply line disruption (submarine)
SupplyLineDisruption.help: Quick Challenge needs to be unlocked, otherwise it will be skipped

_info.name: Hard mode
_info.help: Running daily Hard mode requires clearing mode to be unlocked. Before unlocking, use the main campaign function instead.

_info.name: Exercises
_info.help: Run Exercise, automatically retreat when HP is too low

DelayUntilHoursBeforeNextUpdate.name: Delay Exercise until X hours before next refresh

ExerciseStrategy.name: Exercise strategy
ExerciseStrategy.help: If you reserve 5 attempts, you will try to push for marshal rank at the set time, and all attempts will be cleared after the refresh at 18:00 on Sunday.

LowHpThreshold.name: Retreat when HP drops below X

LowHpConfirmWait.name: After HP falls below threshold, wait X seconds before retreating
LowHpConfirmWait.help: Recommended 1.0 ~ 3.0, because the character portrait may cover the HP bar, so a brief confirmation period is needed.

OpponentRefreshValue.name: Opponents refreshed X times today
OpponentRefreshValue.help:
Automatically updated value, resets at midnight.
If you manually refresh opponents, you should update this value.

_info.name: META assist
_info.help: Beacon assist three times a day

Tier.name: Find beacons with level above X
Tier.help: If you try several times and still can't find a beacon that meets the criteria, fight a random one.

_info.name: Operation Siren general settings
_info.help: All Operation Siren features use these settings

UseLogger.name: Use coordinate logger
UseLogger.help: Every time you enter the storage, use all Coordinate Loggers

BuyActionPointLimit.name: Buy action points X times
BuyActionPointLimit.help: Maximum number of times to buy Action Points

OilLimit.name: When buying AP, keep X oil

RepairThreshold.name: Return to port for repair when any ship HP is below X

UseRepairPack.name: Use Repair Toolkit to repair ships
UseRepairPack.help: When enabled, Repair Toolkits from storage will be used to repair ships. Recommended to use with Corrosion 1 leveling.

RepairPackThreshold.name: Use Repair Toolkit when any ship HP is below X
RepairPackThreshold.help:
Only takes effect when "Use Repair Toolkit to repair ships" is enabled.
Only attempts repair after defeating Abyssal, Siren Stronghold, and Monthly Boss.
0.0 ~ 1.0

RepairPackThresholdHazard1.name: Use Repair Toolkit when any ship HP is below X (Corrosion 1)
RepairPackThresholdHazard1.help:
Only takes effect when "Use Repair Toolkit to repair ships" is enabled.
Only attempts repair during Corrosion 1 Leveling.
0.0 ~ 1.0

DoRandomMapEvent.name: Complete random map events
DoRandomMapEvent.help: After completing Auto-Search, scan the map again to purchase from Akashi Shop, use Siren information collection device, use Siren detection device, and unlock two-fleet mechanisms.

AkashiShopFilter.name: Shop filter
AkashiShopFilter.help: By default, only Action Points are purchased. If you want to buy purple coins, set to 'ActionPoint > PurpleCoins'

DebugClipRetentionDays.name: Clip retention days
DebugClipRetentionDays.help: Retention for the post-battle debug recordings of Corrosion 1 leveling and Meowfficer farming. Clips under log/clips/ older than this many days are deleted automatically, so recordings cannot fill up your disk. Set to 0 to keep them forever with no auto cleanup.

NotifyOpsiMail.name: Push Operation Siren notifications
NotifyOpsiMail.help: Send notifications about Corrosion 1 and Meowfficer farming through OnePush. Launcher notifications are controlled separately by "Launcher notifications". May be noisy due to high message volume.

LauncherPush.name: Launcher notifications
LauncherPush.help: Send Operation Siren notifications to the launcher and Windows notification channel. Disabling this only affects launcher notifications and does not affect OnePush.

IndependentPush.name: Independent Operation Siren push
IndependentPush.help:
When enabled, Operation Siren notifications will be pushed via the Operation Siren push provider below
When disabled, notifications will be pushed via the Error provider
Before enabling, please enable push notifications for individual events, such as: Corrosion 1, Meowfficer Farming, etc.

OpsiOnePushConfig.name: Operation Siren notifications push settings
OpsiOnePushConfig.help:
Push settings for Operation Siren notifications
When Operation Siren push is enabled, notifications will only be sent if this option is enabled
Operation Siren push settings allow setting different OnePush providers from error notifications
When the independent push is disabled, notifications will be pushed via the error notification provider

AutoSearchTimeLimit.name: Auto-search time limit
AutoSearchTimeLimit.help: Unit: minutes. During auto search, the script will assume the game is stuck if no event is detected for this period.

SkipStrategicSearchCheck.name: Skip plan battle option checks
SkipStrategicSearchCheck.help: When looping a single zone (Corrosion 1 leveling / Meowfficer farming), open the plan battle panel and confirm directly without scroll-checking every option. The panel options must already be configured in-game (zone mode: repeat, stop on merchant/device, auto-submit missions); let the task run once normally, or configure them manually first.

OneHitMode.name: Hit and run
OneHitMode.help:
Only attack each beacon once, then call for assist every half hour.
Does not work on Dossier beacons.

DossierAutoAttackMode.name: Dossier beacon auto combat
DossierAutoAttackMode.help: Automatically fight after the first battle at the Dossier beacon. Currently only available on CN Server.

RequestAssist.name: Request assist
RequestAssist.help:
Before fighting a beacon, request assist from friends, guild, and world.
Does not work on Dossier beacons.

EnsureFullyCollected.name: Ensure collecting 200 beacon data per day
EnsureFullyCollected.help: Before collection is full, the AP reserve setting is temporarily ignored. Requires "Meowfficer Farming" to be enabled.

AutoCollectShip.name: Automatically obtain new META ships
AutoCollectShip.help: New META ships will be automatically obtained when collecting rewards. When disabled, the "Click to Sync" button will not be clicked and must be collected manually.

Filter.name: Sortie fleet filter
Filter.help:
Fight the BOSS in rotation. If one fleet dies, replace it with another.
Please make sure the fleet is strong enough to ultimately defeat the BOSS.
Use "Call submarine" to call a submarine before combat, but the run interval will be increased to 60 minutes.

Submarine.name: Call submarine
Submarine.help: When enabled, the running interval will increase to 60 minutes

_info.name: Monthly exploration
_info.help:
Explore all sea zones in Operation Siren at the beginning of each month, without needing to buy a Campaign Information Recorder (5000 Oil item).
This function will clear a sea zone every 27 minutes to ensure airspace search cooldown.
The following conditions must be met before using this feature:
- Complete Operation Siren main story and finish Simulation Battle + Siren Proving Ground
Smart and monthly exploration cannot be enabled together. Disable the monthly exploration task before enabling smart exploration. If monthly exploration reached 100% this month, smart exploration is unnecessary and skips all three routes.

SpecialRadar.name: Campaign Information Recorder has been purchased (5000 Oil item)
SpecialRadar.help:
The Campaign Information Recorder is not required.
Cannot be checked if not purchased and used.

ForceRun.name: Force run regardless of run interval
ForceRun.help: When enabled, it will consume additional AP. Generally not needed, just take it slowly.

LastZone.name: Last completed zone
LastZone.help:
Automatically updated value. Fill in 0 to reset progress. After reset, already explored sea zones will be automatically skipped.
Supports sea zone ID, CN/EN/JP/TW server zone names, e.g. "51", "NA Ocean SE Sector E"

AllowHazard1Leveling.name: Allow Corrosion 1 leveling during exploration
AllowHazard1Leveling.help: If enabled, Corrosion 1 Leveling will not be postponed. Use with caution, as you might run out of Action Points for exploration.

MeowfficerCleanup.name: Post-exploration event cleanup
MeowfficerCleanup.help: After all monthly exploration zones are confirmed complete, revisit ordinary zones in exploration order and scan the full map and every fleet radar for missed events, including Akashi shops, logging towers, scanning devices and exploration rewards. Progress is saved per zone and completed only once per month. Stop for inspection after three unfinished attempts in one zone. Only enter the original ordinary (DANGEROUS) zones; never enter or refresh SAFE zones. Fight enemies generated by missed events using existing event logic, without repeatedly farming zones.

ExploreProgress.name: Monthly exploration progress
ExploreProgress.help: Shows the current completion percentage of monthly exploration.

_info.name: Ordinary-zone event cleanup
_info.help: Requires 100% monthly exploration. Revisit original DANGEROUS zones in exploration order, scan the full map and every fleet radar, and handle missed events and their enemies. Never enter SAFE zones. Uses separate monthly checkpoints saved after leaving each zone, without repeating completed months. If exploration is incomplete, ask to rerun monthly exploration.

Progress.name: Cleanup progress
Progress.help: Completed zones for this task only; monthly exploration progress is unchanged.

_info.name: Operation Siren shop
_info.help:
The following conditions must be met before using this feature:
- Complete Operation Siren main story and finish Simulation Battle + Siren Proving Ground
- Enable Operation Siren exploration or use Campaign Information Recorder (5000 Oil item)
- The month after completing Operation Siren main story, i.e. when the Port Shop becomes the new version.

PresetFilter.name: Port Shop filter
PresetFilter.help:
Generally the default is sufficient. If free vouchers overflow, select "High value items and META materials". For beginners, select "Do not purchase META materials" which buys everything except META materials.
High-value items are AP, coordinates, and gold or higher tier products; META materials include META general tactical textbooks and 4 types of enhancement materials.
PresetFilter.max_benefit_meta: High value items and META materials

CustomFilter.name: Custom filter
CustomFilter.help: To use a custom filter, set "Port Shop Filter" to "Custom" and read https://github.com/LmeSzinc/AzurLaneAutoScript/wiki/filter_string_cn

DisableBeforeDate.name: Do not purchase from OpSi shop before the Xth day of each month
DisableBeforeDate.help:
Starting from the day after the specified date, buy from Operation Siren Shop once a day.
0 means no limit, buy every day.

_info.name: Special exchange shop (monthly voucher shop)
_info.help:
Purchase from the monthly voucher shop.
The following conditions must be met before using this feature:
- Complete Operation Siren main story and finish Simulation Battle + Siren Proving Ground

_info.name: Operation Siren daily
_info.help:
The following conditions must be met before using this feature:
- Clear the Operation Siren main storyline and complete Simulation Battle + Siren Proving Ground
- Enable Operation Siren Exploration mission or use the Campaign Information Recorder (5000 Oil item)

DoMission.name: Do Operation Siren daily
DoMission.help: Pick up dailies at port and complete all dailies

UseTuningSample.name: Use tuning samples
UseTuningSample.help: Use all six Tuning Samples and the strong Tuning Sample

SkipSirenResearchMission.name: Skip Siren Research missions
SkipSirenResearchMission.help:
When enabled, "Siren Research I" and "Siren Research II" missions will be skipped.
Siren Research missions exchange yellow coins for purple coins.

KeepMissionZone.name: Keep sea zone without clearing
KeepMissionZone.help:
Exit the sea zone after completing the daily. Next time a mission appears in the same zone, no AP is needed to enter.
All uncleaned zones will be cleaned on the last day of every month.

MissionZones.name: Sea zones to be cleaned at month end
MissionZones.help: This value is automatically recorded and generally does not need to be modified.

DeferredMissions.name: Deferred mission records
DeferredMissions.help: Stores unavailable mission zones and retry times. Other daily missions continue normally.

_info.name: Obscured zone
_info.help:
Clear an Obscured Zone every 27 minutes to ensure the zone search cooldown
The following conditions must be met before using this feature:
- Clear the Operation Siren main storyline and complete Simulation Battle + Siren Proving Ground
- Enable Operation Siren Exploration mission or use the Campaign Information Recorder (5000 Oil item)

SkipHazard2Obscure.name: Skip Corrosion Level 2 coordinates
SkipHazard2Obscure.help: When enabled, Obscured Zones with Corrosion Level 2 will not be cleared.

ForceRun.name: Force run ignoring interval
ForceRun.help: When enabled, it will consume additional Action Points. Generally not needed, just run it slowly.

_info.name: Abyssal zone
_info.help:
Clear the Abyssal Zone coordinates in inventory
The following conditions must be met before using this feature:
- Clear the Operation Siren main storyline and complete Simulation Battle + Siren Proving Ground
- Enable Operation Siren Exploration mission or use the Campaign Information Recorder (5000 Oil item)

ForceRun.name: Force run ignoring interval
ForceRun.help: When enabled, it will consume additional Action Points. Generally not needed, just run it slowly.

_info.name: Siren stronghold
_info.help:
Clear the weekly Siren Stronghold
The following conditions must be met before using this feature:
- Clear the Operation Siren main storyline and complete Simulation Battle + Siren Proving Ground
- Enable Operation Siren Exploration mission or use the Campaign Information Recorder (5000 Oil item)

SubmarineEveryCombat.name: Submarine sortie every battle
SubmarineEveryCombat.help: When enabled, if there is a submarine fleet in the sortie fleet filter and the submarine fleet runs out of ammo, it will exit the Siren Stronghold and postpone the mission.

ForceRun.name: Force run ignoring interval
ForceRun.help: When enabled, it will consume additional Action Points. Generally not needed, just run it slowly.

HasStronghold.name: Siren stronghold available
HasStronghold.help: Execute when a Siren Stronghold is detected on the map

_info.name: Monthly boss
_info.help:
Clear the (Normal/Hard) Monthly Boss. On Normal difficulty, will continue attacking until defeated. On Hard difficulty, will terminate the task directly upon failure.
The following conditions must be met before using this feature:
- Clear the Operation Siren main storyline and complete Simulation Battle + Siren Proving Ground
- Enable Operation Siren Exploration mission or use the Campaign Information Recorder (5000 Oil item)

CheckAdaptability.name: Only fight BOSS when adaptability is above 203/203/156

ForceRun.name: Force run ignoring interval
ForceRun.help: When enabled, it will consume additional Action Points. Generally not needed, just run it slowly.

_info.name: Meowfficer farming
_info.help:
Attack sea zones with designated Corrosion levels in clockwise order
The following conditions must be met before using this feature:
- Clear the Operation Siren main storyline and complete Simulation Battle + Siren Proving Ground
- Enable Operation Siren Exploration mission or use the Campaign Information Recorder (5000 Oil item)

ActionPointPreserve.name: Preserve X action points
ActionPointPreserve.help:
Stop when Action Points are lower than X, and automatically open Action Point boxes. X includes Action Points in boxes. It is recommended to preserve 3000 AP for Corrosion 1 Leveling.
This value will be automatically reduced to 200 points 3 days before Operation Siren reset. If Corrosion 1 Leveling is enabled, it will be changed to 1000 points, and will be automatically reduced to 0 points on the last day.

HazardLevel.name: Corrosion level
HazardLevel.help:
Attack sea zones with specific Corrosion levels in clockwise order
It is recommended to choose 5 or 3, which has a higher cat point/AP ratio.

TargetZone.name: Target zone
TargetZone.help:
Only attack the designated sea zone. Supports zone IDs and CN/EN/JP/TW zone names. Use 0 to return to the default logic by Corrosion level.
When Planned Operation in Target Zone is enabled, multiple zones can be entered and cycled in order, e.g. 42,55,45, 42, 55, 45, or 42, 55, 45.

StayInZone.name: Planned operation in target zone
StayInZone.help: After enabling this, the task runs according to Target Zone. With one zone it stays there; with multiple zones it cycles through them in the configured order. Only takes effect when Target Zone is not 0.

ExecuteFixedPatrolScan.name: Fixed patrol scan
ExecuteFixedPatrolScan.help: After enabling this, the task will scan the fixed patrol zone every 10 seconds.

DebugClip.name: Post-battle debug recording
DebugClip.help: When enabled, during each Meowfficer-farming round's post-battle handling (event detection / event resolution / forced movement), record what ALAS itself sees into an mp4 under log/clips/ (filename starts with meow_clip_). Every round is saved, whether or not an event occurred, so you can review each round. Retention is configured under OS General Settings.

TargetZone.name: Target zone
TargetZone.help:
Only sortie to specified zones. Can be used to earn Operation Siren achievement stars.
Supports zone ID, CN/EN/JP/TW zone names, e.g. "51", "NA Ocean SE Sector E"
Enter default value 0 or delete the value to cancel targeting.

LastRun.name: Last claim time
LastRun.help: This value is auto-recorded and generally does not need modification.

_info.name: Corrosion 1 leveling
_info.help:
Consume Combat Supply Vouchers to gain large amounts of EXP and small amounts of Action Points
It is recommended to bring 1-2 preloaded carriers to obtain the highest hourly income.

Some safety restrictions of the original AzurPilot have been lifted, please set parameters carefully

TargetZone.name: Target zone
TargetZone.help: Only attack the designated zone, can be used to avoid zone refresh issues caused by game bugs

OperationCoinsPreserve.name: Preserve X combat supply vouchers
OperationCoinsPreserve.help: When Combat Supply Vouchers are lower than X, run Meowfficer Farming. Not recommended to modify.

MinimumActionPointReserve.name: Preserve X action points
MinimumActionPointReserve.help: Give it a try, the bicycle turns into a motorcycle. Yukikaze-sama has given the luck to Commander nanoda, go for it nanoda!

ExecuteFixedPatrolScan.name: Post-battle forced movement (efficiency mode)
ExecuteFixedPatrolScan.help: When enabled, after each battle ALAS cycles through fleets 1-4 and checks each radar for remaining question marks (switching fleets only, moving none), and handles Akashi / logging tower / Siren device if found. If that is not enough, it moves fleets one by one and rescans the whole map, with fixed destinations C1/D1/E1/F1 (only fit for the Hazard-1 map): if some fleet saw a question mark it could not reach (blocked / out of movement range) it moves right away; only when no fleet saw anything does it check the current action points, moving only when they are above 7, otherwise saving them for the next round. Default off. Meowfficer Farming does not use this; it only switches fleets and checks radars.

SkipHpCheck.name: Sacrifice run: skip HP check
SkipHpCheck.help: Skip HP check after combat. Fleet will continue even if ships are sunk.

Cl1Filter.name: Akashi purchase filter
Cl1Filter.help: By default, only Action Points are purchased. If you want to also buy purple coins, set it to "ActionPoint > PurpleCoins"

RecordNonCL1AP.name: Record non-Corrosion 1 AP sources
RecordNonCL1AP.help: When enabled, AP acquisition data from all sources (such as Akashi shop purchases) will be recorded. When disabled, AP data will only be recorded during Corrosion 1 Leveling tasks, ignoring AP gained during other tasks or manual operations.

RecordSeaMiles.name: Sea miles recording
RecordSeaMiles.help: Record sea miles to statistics after each Corrosion 1 leveling cycle

DebugClip.name: Post-battle debug recording
DebugClip.help: When enabled, during each Corrosion 1 round's post-battle handling (rescan / event resolution / forced movement), record what ALAS itself sees into an mp4 under log/clips/. Every round is saved, whether or not an event occurred, so you can review each round. Use this to manually verify whether Akashi is missed. Clips are cleaned up automatically according to the clip retention setting under OS General Settings.

_info.name: Siren research device
_info.help: Basic options for handling Siren Research Devices

SirenResearch_Enable.name: Enable Siren research device
SirenResearch_Enable.help:
After enabling, use purple coins to convert to yellow coins through the Siren Research Device
Sufficient nautical miles are needed to sustain the purple coin consumption

Siren_Mode.name: Interaction mode with Siren detection device
Siren_Mode.help: Choose how to interact with Siren devices. Detecting resources costs purple coins (Special Exchange Vouchers), detecting enemies costs Siren Energy Storage
Siren_Mode.resource: Repeatedly attempt to detect hidden resources
Siren_Mode.enemy: Repeatedly attempt to detect hidden enemies

Siren_Fleet.name: Fleet for enemy detection
Siren_Fleet.help: Select the fleet to use when detecting hidden enemies. 0 means use current fleet, 1-4 means use specified fleet

_info.name: Operation Siren fleet EXP check
_info.help:
Check whether all ships in the sortie fleet have gained full experience, and if so, send a push notification.
You need to configure "Error Push Settings" in AzurPilot settings first.

TargetLevel.name: Push when all ships can level up to this level (0 means no limit)
TargetLevel.help: When all ships have accumulated enough experience to reach the specified level, a push notification is triggered.

LastRun.name: Last EXP check time (auto-recorded)
LastRun.help: Records the time of last check to prevent repeated runs, check interval is 1 day. This value is auto-recorded and generally does not need manual modification.

CheckInterval.name: Check interval (hours)
CheckInterval.help: How many hours between each experience check. Default is 24 hours.

EnableCustomCheck.name: Enable custom ship check
EnableCustomCheck.help: Check only specified ships instead of all ships.

CustomCheckPositions.name: Custom check positions
CustomCheckPositions.help: Ship position numbers 1-6, separated by comma. Only these positions will be checked.

DelayAfterFull.name: Delay task after reaching target level
DelayAfterFull.help: When full experience is detected, this task will be delayed for the specified duration.

_info.name: Fleet auto-compose
_info.help: Automatically replace ships that have reached the target level.

Enable.name: Enable auto-compose
Enable.help: Automatically replace ships that have reached max level.

CooldownHours.name: Cooldown hours
CooldownHours.help: Cooldown period in hours after an auto-compose before the next one.

LastRun.name: Last run time (auto-recorded)
LastRun.help: Records the last auto-compose execution time. Do not modify manually.

_info.name: Smart scheduling
_info.help:
Operation Siren smart scheduling function, used to coordinate switching between Corrosion 1 Leveling and yellow coin replenishment tasks.
Once enabled, it will automatically switch between different tasks and send push notifications based on coins and Action Points.

Some safety restrictions of the original AzurPilot have been lifted, please set parameters carefully

BuyActionPoint.name: Buy port AP when AP is insufficient
BuyActionPoint.help: Allowed only after monthly exploration reaches 100% or smart round one finishes this month. Neither exploration task needs to remain enabled. Once per month, buy all port-shop AP boxes without spending oil. Also triggers at 1360 AP or below after round one; otherwise at the CL1 AP reserve or when a subtask runs out of AP. May spend coins reserved for leveling; sufficient currency is required. Record the monthly purchase when the buying flow finishes, without rescanning other goods. Interrupted purchases can resume; no AP stock left also completes the flow.

UseSmartSchedulingOperationCoinsPreserve.name: Coin target scheduling
UseSmartSchedulingOperationCoinsPreserve.help: When enabled, replenish coins to the coin reserve plus the refill amount before returning to corrosion 1 leveling. When disabled, use AP scheduling and replenish coins until AP reaches its reserve. Both modes use Smart Scheduling's own coin reserve.

OperationCoinsPreserve.name: Smart Scheduling: preserve X combat supply vouchers
OperationCoinsPreserve.help: When Combat Supply Vouchers are lower than X, run yellow coin replenishment task. Not recommended to modify.

ActionPointPreserve.name: Coin replenishment: preserve X action points
ActionPointPreserve.help: Stop coin replenishment when total AP reaches X. Total AP includes AP in boxes. Set to 0 to use the Meowfficer Farming AP reserve.

OperationCoinsReturnThreshold.name: Coin refill amount
OperationCoinsReturnThreshold.help: In coin target scheduling, replenish coins to the coin reserve plus X before returning to corrosion 1 leveling. AP scheduling does not use this amount.

EnableMeowfficerFarming.name: Enable meowfficer farming
EnableMeowfficerFarming.help: Whether to enable Meowfficer Farming task for yellow coin replenishment in Smart Scheduling

EnableObscure.name: Enable obscured zone
EnableObscure.help: Whether to enable Obscured Zone task for yellow coin replenishment in Smart Scheduling

EnableAbyssal.name: Enable abyssal zone
EnableAbyssal.help: Whether to enable Abyssal Zone task for yellow coin replenishment in Smart Scheduling

EnableStronghold.name: Enable Siren stronghold
EnableStronghold.help: Whether to enable Siren Stronghold task for yellow coin replenishment in Smart Scheduling

TaskPriority.name: Replenishment task priority
TaskPriority.help: The priority order of tasks for yellow coin replenishment when they are insufficient. Separated by >.

ObscureAbyssalCheckDelayDays.name: Obscure/Abyssal recheck delay (days)
ObscureAbyssalCheckDelayDays.help: After all Obscure Zones and Abyssal Zones are cleared, Smart Scheduling delays their checks by the given number of days and skips them in the meantime to speed up coin replenishing. 0 checks every round. The Operation Siren monthly reset refreshes them, and checks resume after the reset.

MonthEndActionPointCleanupEnable.name: Enable month-end action point cleanup
MonthEndActionPointCleanupEnable.help: Whether to enable the month-end Action Point cleanup. When enabled, once the days remaining until the Operation Siren reset are at or below the "Month-end Action Point Cleanup Days" value, the month-end cleanup mode starts to consume Action Points.

MonthEndActionPointCleanupDays.name: Month-end action point cleanup days
MonthEndActionPointCleanupDays.help: Start the month-end Action Point cleanup mode when the days remaining until the Operation Siren reset are at or below this value. 0 disables it. When enabled, the cleanup loop repeatedly runs Meowfficer Farming, shop purchases, Obscured Zones and Abyssal Zones to consume Action Points, and summons the Siren Stronghold on the first run.

MonthEndActionPointPreserve.name: Month-end action point preserve
MonthEndActionPointPreserve.help: Action Point preserve value in month-end cleanup mode. If the cross-month daily task is enabled, at least 200 Action Points are reserved. When this value is larger than the minimum reserve, this value is used.

MonthEndMeowTargetZone.name: Month-end meowfficer target zone
MonthEndMeowTargetZone.help: When month-end cleanup delegates to Meowfficer farming, only sortie into the designated sea zone. Supports zone IDs and names. Use 0 or leave empty to follow the Meowfficer farming settings. Multiple zones or an invalid zone fall back to 0; whether the task keeps cycling in that zone follows the "Planned operation in target zone" option of Meowfficer farming.

MonthEndShopPurchase.name: Month-end shop purchase
MonthEndShopPurchase.help: Whether to buy from the Operation Siren shop during month-end Action Point cleanup. When disabled, the cleanup loop skips the shop purchase step.

_info.name: Smart exploration

ScheduledEmulatorRestart.name: Restart the emulator regularly
ScheduledEmulatorRestart.help:
Restart the emulator every so often to prevent it from getting slow or leaky after running for a long time.
Note: By default, it waits for the current task to finish before restarting.

ForceScheduledRestart.name: Restart on schedule (don't wait for task)
ForceScheduledRestart.help:
When enabled, restarts the emulator right on schedule, without waiting for the current task to finish.
But if a sensitive task is currently running, it will still wait for it to finish.
Requires 'Restart the emulator regularly' above to be on. Default off.

RestartIntervalHours.name: How often to restart (hours)
RestartIntervalHours.help: How many hours between emulator restarts.

DeepRestartAfterFailures.name: Deep restart after N failures
DeepRestartAfterFailures.help:
Once the emulator has failed to restart this many times in a row, switch to a deep restart: kill every MuMu process (including background services and the VM) and start over.
A last-resort escape hatch for weak machines where normal restarts never come up.
Note: a deep restart also kills any other MuMu instances you are running.
0 disables it (restart the instance only). Default 0.
